output.explanation: The name field had a script that blocked the Tab key (preventDefault), so keyboard users could never leave the field. The fix keeps the trimming of extra spaces but no longer cancels the Tab key, so focus moves to the next field normally.

output.technique: Remove e.preventDefault() on the Tab key so default focus navigation works while keeping the trim formatting.
